notes.title: Berninalinie: Tirano - Ospizio Bernina - Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/95928b38f065451750f1ec20e764593dcd36cc9e.jpg[/img]

Time to cross yet another border! Alpine mountains, snow covered track and steep, steep gradients are coming soon with Berninaline: Tirano - Ospizio Bernina, releasing on January 16th courtesy of Rivet Games!

[i]Pre-order now on Steam with a 10% discount![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584110/Train_Sim_World_4_Berninalinie_Tirano__Ospizio_Bernina_Route_AddOn/

[previewyoutube=wlj6c3gUQhI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]The Route[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/6dca078340018c42a945e8da8ab9282a01fbe121.jpg[/img]

It’s time to adventure up into the Alps courtesy of the world-renowned RhB services that weave and wind their way through Switzerland and over the border into Italy. Another new country sneaks its way into Train Sim World with the Italian town of Tirano forming an end point of this latest route Add-on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/cae8a9b59a6867ecdcc6ed8c22546af04a511926.jpg[/img]

First opened in 1908, this historic single-track metre-gauge (3 ft 3+3⁄8 in) railway line winds its way up into the mountains along gradients as steep as 7% (1:14), some of the steepest gradients for an adhesion railway in the world! Built primarily to serve tourists and locals as well as facilitate access to hydro-electric plants, this spectacular line continues to wow passengers from around the globe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/36c8f30feb4d67b89a86c73b37e4ecc92e5f6ef9.jpg[/img]

In-game, the route extends out from Tirano, which sits at 429m above sea level and heads up to the highest point of the line at Ospizio Bernina, in Switzerland at a height of 2253m. Along the way, the route twists and winds up the gradients, first looping back on itself via the Brusio Spiral Viaduct, just south of Brusio, before passing by the Lago di Poschiavo and traversing a number of tight turns prior to the summit. Beyond the impressive natural landscape, trains head through towns with some street running and custom road traffic features in-game that stops for each passing train.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/9a35d6c15b0350889ae6381da081af4bdf9a9263.jpg[/img]

Dramatic mountains, wintry landscapes and alpine scenery define the views for both passengers and drivers throughout, recreated through use of 1m LIDAR and other landscaping tools. Custom winter features include the ice at Lago Bianco and glacier assets at Alp Grüm.

[h2][b]The ABe 8/12 Allegra EMU[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/29ea02e5d642c5525500db6dc92be66bfb8b2354.jpg[/img]

Making the steady climb up to Ospizio Bernina is the ABe 8/12 Allegra EMU, operated by the Rhaetian Railway or RhB. First introduced in 2009, this dual voltage EMU is able to run off the 1000 V DC power of the Bernina Line in addition to the 11 kV, 16.7 Hz power seen on the rest of the Rhaetian Railway’s core network. The Allegra even holds the speed record for metre-gauge railways, clocking 139 km/h (86 mph) during a test run on another railway in 2009.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/4df13a886a67c4e9b54b0d8058f989294fadbca7.jpg[/img]

Though the RhB might be familiar to players of previous Swiss route Add-ons, this modern and stylish EMU provides contemporary traction to get to grips with. The 3-car unit has the ability to attach to and haul additional cars up the mountain and this function extends to freight, giving players an unusual operational opportunity.

The Allegra’s performance ensures that it can handle the tight curves and steep climbs with ease, but drivers will have to be wary of stopping and hill starting when perched high upon the mountaintop!

Also included in this route Add-on is a selection of additional rolling stock to allow for the running of mixed consists behind the Allegra:
[list]
[*] RhB ZA Tank Wagon
[*] RhB SP-W Timber Wagon
[*] EW-1 A and B coaches
[/list]

[h2][b]Services and Gameplay[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/43783f7a5ab4dde00be95eb3a5e50f53168c65a5.jpg[/img]

Services on this stretch of the Bernina Line consist primarily of Tirano – St. Moritz services that stop at Ospizio Bernina before running out of the map. There are 49 services in total, with six half-way services from either Tirano or Ospizio Bernina to Poschiavo, where shunting moves can be operated in the morning.

Three BEX (Bernina Express) services form part of the timetable, consisting of a run up and down with a shunting manoeuvre at Tirano. These trains feature the open-air coach from the RhB Anniversary Collection Add-On for players that own it.

The Allegra will feature fully implemented passenger announcements, building on a similar feature found in Rivet Games’ ScotRail Express Add-on. Unlike the Class 385 however, these will automatically play out at relevant points and will feature the three different languages spoken in the region: English, German and Italian.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/edb0a13970053897731a7d9fc68508aafe905dd4.jpg[/img]

Five Scenarios are included – which are centred around picking up additional stock and freight wagons:
[list]
[*] Scenic Views: Takes the player along a winter ride from Ospizio Bernina to Tirano, stopping along the way at scenic locations.
[*] Early Morning Shift: Starts with the player boarding an AI train to travel to Poschiavo, where they then take over a new train to Tirano.
[*] Hot Wheels: Takes the player from Tirano all the way up to Ospizio Bernina, with coupling up another wagon at Campocologno and then decoupling one due to a hot axle in Cavaglia
[*] Close Call Delivery: Takes the player from Poschiavo up towards Ospizio Bernina, delivering tanker wagons along the way.
[*] A Train Filled with Christmas Spirit: Santa was a bit delayed getting to the mountains in this Christmas-themed scenario! This service operates from Ospizio Bernina down to Tirano through a snowstorm, delivering presents to each station, which the player unloads manually.
[/list]

The difference in voltage between routes prevents locomotives such as the RhB Ge 4/4 II from Arosalinie running on Berninalinie, so there are no service layers from that route Add-on, but the dual-voltage Allegra can be operated in Free Roam on Arosalinie. This offers a distinctly different feel to operating the Allegra, due to the difference between AC and DC power systems, which are fully simulated.
Along the Bernina Line there’ll be some unique collectibles to find, including Italian Pizza and distinct Alpine Hats!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584110/Train_Sim_World_4_Berninalinie_Tirano__Ospizio_Bernina_Route_AddOn/

Join the Railfan TV team, joined by guests from Rivet Games on Twitch and YouTube at 18:00 UTC on January 11th for a preview of Train Sim World 4: Berninaline: Tirano - Ospizio Bernina.

Find out more about Train Sim World 4 by following @trainsimworld on [b][url=https://twitter.com/trainsimworld]Twitter[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/trainsim/]Instagram[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/trainsimworld]Facebook[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/user/RailSimulatorDotCom]YouTube[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/trainsimworldofficial]Twitch[/url][/b], and [b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@trainsimworldofficial]TikTok[/url][/b].

notes.title: The Steam Winter Sales are here!
notes.content:
The Holiday season is finally here, and you know what that means: jolly cheer, good food and festive discounts on our favourite games!

[h2]21st December 2023 - 4th January 2024[/h2]

Come in from the cold, get cosy round the PC and surround yourself in the warmth of some mega discounts on Train Sim World content! The Steam Winter Sale is now on!

[h2]Steam Exclusive Bundles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/c40e918e357464975bbc38363ef90b900e274676.jpg[/img]

If you're looking jump on multiple bargains during the sale, be sure to check out Steam Exclusive Bundles, where you can save more by buying selected Add-ons together. There's also a 'Complete My Collection' function, meaning you can still save even if you own some of the content featured! Bundles include:

[b][list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35748/Train_Sim_World_4_UK_Expansion_Bundle/]UK Expansion Bundle[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35749/Train_Sim_World_4_USA_Expansion_Bundle/]USA Expansion Bundle[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35747/Train_Sim_World_4_European_Expansion_Bundle/]European Expansion Bundle[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35746/Train_Sim_World_4_German_Expansion_Bundle/]German Expansion Bundle[/url]
[/list][/b]

[h2]TSW4: Deluxe Edition & Holiday Express[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/8af92149e4e297a974eb3b4b67a64e3b04a57de1.jpg[/img]

Free Roam, Photo Mode, updated Creators Club tools and the PC Editor (beta) - all come to Train Sim World 4! In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sub/937007/]Deluxe Edition, now 45% off[/url], play more services across the three core routes with the iconic Flying Scotsman steam locomotive and state-of-the-art Vectron.

For that extra bit of Holiday magic, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386155/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_The_Holiday_Express__Runaway_Elf/]The Holiday Express - Runaway Elf is now available at 70% off[/url], allowing for festive fun within a 1980s living room and the toy-like Richie Rails F7! Hunt down the naughty elf and clamber through chairs, toys and Christmas presents in a series of challenges and Scenarios!

[h2]UK Route Add-ons[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/054839537856667429c0827ca2771996b3959aee.jpg[/img]

Travel along some of Britain's arterial high-speed lines in both the Midlands and the South with Skyhook Games' [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386174/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Midland_Main_Line_Leicester__Derby__Nottingham_Route_AddOn/]Midland Main Line now 30% off[/url] and the popular [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375860/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Great_Western_Express_Route_AddOn/]Great Western Express now 60% off[/url]!

[url=https://forums.dovetailgames.com/threads/winter-core-update-part-1.76999/?_ga=2.168594785.1940281254.1702888727-757731819.1682247965#post-765330]Midland Main Line has received a host of upgrades recently[/url] making it better than ever, including improvements to the scenery and environment and the implementation of Volumetric Fog for Train Sim World 4 players.

For something a little slower paced, the scenic heritage journeys along the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375862/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_West_Somerset_Railway_Route_AddOn/]West Somerset Railway, now 60% off[/url], offer vintage diesel running along the north Somerset coast.

In our [url=https://live.dovetailgames.com/live/train-sim-world/articles/article/train-sim-world-4-roadmap-december-2023]December Roadmap[/url], we announced a significant update coming for this route Add-on including a small route extension and new timetable for players with Train Sim World 4. We'll reveal more details on this next year!

[h2]European Routes and Locomotives
German Content[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/5550ee4aa2407b370c1231b6c0d1fdaecca8aeb1.jpg[/img]
If you're a fan of all things Deutsche Bahn then there's plenty of content in the sale to keep you going over the holidays!

For some 1990s nostalgia there are two stunning routes to take. Master the 'Legend' DB BR 103 along the Rhine in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386173/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Linke_Rheinstrecke_Mainz__Koblenz_Route_AddOn/]Linke Rheinstrecke, now 40% off[/url]! If you prefer the rumble of Diesel running through the rural German countryside, then the detailed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386141/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Niddertalbahn_Bad_Vilbel__Stockheim_Route_AddOn/]Niddertalbahn route is now 30% off[/url], featuring the DB BR 628.2

Wanting more for your existing timetable? There are Loco Add-ons aplenty, including the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386177/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_DB_BR_403_ICE_3_Railbow_AddOn/]DB BR 403 ICE 3 Railbow, now 25% off[/url], adding Scenarios to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386127/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Schnellfahrstrecke_Kassel__Wrzburg_Route_AddOn/]Schnellfahrstrecke Kassel - Würzburg[/url].

There are Add-ons from elsewhere in Europe in the sale too! If you've yet to head into Switzerland, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36588/Train_Sim_World_4_Arosalinie_Enhancement_Bundle/]Train Sim World 4: Arosalinie Enhancement Bundle[/url] will see you get the most of Rivet Games' Arosa Line Add-on with additional liveries, Scenarios and rolling stock. There's also French high-speed action to be had in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375909/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_LGV_Mediterranee_Marseille__Avignon_Route_AddOn/]LGV Méditerranée, now 60% off[/url]!

[h2]US Passenger Content[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/e70465a000fa9501d0696007f4d7a2d889ece155.jpg[/img]
Hauling millions of passengers across the States are some of the most iconic railroad brands and trains - with many featuring in Train Sim World Add-ons!

Run at high speed along the Northeast Corridor between [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386110/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Northeast_Corridor_Boston__Providence_Route_AddOn/]Boston and Providence[/url] in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386158/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Amtraks_Acela/]Amtrak's Acela®[/url] with both the route Add-on and loco Add-on on sale at 70% and 45% off respectively.

Fancy the West Coast instead? With some recent updates and fixes implemented, now's a great time to enter Caltrain's services with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375893/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Peninsula_Corridor_San_Francisco__San_Jose_Route_AddOn/]Peninsula Corridor, now a massive 80% off[/url]!

There's plenty of US freight action in the sale too, from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386128/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Cajon_Pass_Barstow__San_Bernardino_Route_AddOn/]Cajon Pass[/url], to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386111/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Horseshoe_Curve_Altoona__Johnstown__South_Fork_Route_AddOn/]Horseshoe Curve[/url]. And [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386144/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Sand_Patch_Grade_Route_AddOn/]Sand Patch Grade[/url] to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375898/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Canadian_National_Oakville_Subdivision_Hamilton__Oakville_Route_AddOn/]Canadian National Oakville Subdivision[/url].

[h2]The Steam Awards - Vote for TSW4[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/fe2994b6d0a25a7cff4fd9844ab3189a2219c628.jpg[/img]

Train Sim World 4 is through to the finals of the Steam Awards! Thank you to all the would-be drivers, engineers and simulation gamers for nominating us for the Sit Back & Relax Award! But the journey's not over yet. Now's the time to notch the throttle forward again and get us to our destination... the winner's trophy.

Head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards]Steam Awards page[/url] to enter your nominations - winners are revealed on Tuesday 2nd January!

Find out more about Train Sim World 4 by following @trainsimworld on [url=https://twitter.com/trainsimworld]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/trainsim/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/trainsimworld/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/RailSimulatorDotCom]YouTube[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/trainsimworldofficial]Twitch[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@trainsimworldofficial]TikTok[/url].

notes.title: Centro Regional Railways Class 323 - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/5cb74d43185b0f17be810dd8895d2e960a3350c0.jpg[/img]

Celebrate the Centro brand with the first Train Sim World release by Partner Programme Developer SimTrack Studios. Centro Regional Railways Class 323 Add-on is out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584090/Train_Sim_World_4_Centro_Regional_Railways_BR_Class_323_AddOn/

[h2][b]Adding 323221 to the roster[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/397a022ca0ffedac077a628b3ed66d1ef929c0a8.jpg[/img]

Last year, West Midlands Railway decided to apply the 1990s era Centro livery to one of its Class 323 units: no.323221. After a visit to Soho Depot, home of social media’s Hunslet the Bear, the unit re-entered service with its new, nostalgic colours on 19th December 2022.

Class 323s were seen in this livery during the 1990s, along with other trains, bus stations and wider transport material produced in the Birmingham and Black Country areas. Commuters of the time will no doubt be familiar with the blue, green and yellow hues, slightly amended for its application on 323221 today.

[h2][b]Additional Scenarios and features[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/5c66923a6b30078bd6a7a143a7d0a35e12e4d917.jpg[/img]

SimTrack are a new Partner Programme Developer to Train Sim World, making their debut by bringing 323221’s livery to life in-game. You can read a little more about SimTrack in our [url=https://live.dovetailgames.com/live/train-sim-world/articles/article/train-sim-world-4-roadmap-november-2023][b]November Roadmap[/b][/url], where they introduce themselves to the Train Sim World Community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/7ea495b928ba23b43948c8e87a0f421ee55307a8.jpg[/img]

The Class 323 EMU has been a popular addition to Train Sim World, first seeing light in the Birmingham Cross-City route Add-on (required to make use of the Centro 323 Add-on), before appearing again in Glossop Line and in Train Sim World 4’s Training Center, where it is shown with some of the experimental Suspension features coming in a later Core Update.

Notable features and updates on SimTrack’s version of the Class 323 include:
[list]
[*] Centro livery as seen on the real-world 323221
[*] Interactive Stabling Tail Lamp under the driver’s seat, required during two of the additional Scenarios
[*] Updated Train Sim World 4 rain effects on the windscreen
[*] Toggleable ‘Hunslet the Bear’ sitting in the cab!
[*] Hunslet the Bear
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/0b8ca4ee1d3746a5d30d2b0770b5bfcceda232df.jpg[/img]

Hunslet the Bear is Soho Depot’s loveable mascot, seen on social media making rolling stock inspections, receiving units at the depot and even time in the cab! As well as being a collectible along the Birmingham Cross-City route (players are required to provide them with hi-vis jackets), they can now be featured in the cab in-game too as part of the Centro Class 323 Add-on.

Five new Scenarios will also be added to Birmingham Cross-City as part of this Add-on, which feature some additions to the environment, including Flashing Emergency Indicators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/5950333c1293b44a7a17f2c840abdbd4f3c39e7c.jpg[/img]

Some minor updates and improvements to the West Midlands Railway Class 323, such as fixed PIS displays and the Secondman seat now being usable, will also be implemented for Train Sim World 4 players that own Birmingham Cross-City.

But that’s not all from SimTrack Studios! Readers of our exciting December Roadmap will have seen a tease for their next bit of Train Sim World content, which should pique (or should that be, ‘peak’) the interest of DMU fans...

Centro Regional Railways BR Class 323 Add-on is available now for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for £4.99/€5.99/$5.99

Making use of the Add-on and its Scenarios requires Train Sim World 4 and the Train Sim World Compatible: Birmingham Cross-City Line route Add-on.

[b]Train Sim World Compatible: Birmingham Cross-City Line: Lichfield - Bromsgrove & Redditch is available separately for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for £29.99/€35.99/$39.99[/b]

notes.title: Cargo Line Vol.1 - Petroleum – Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/109d35867cdf6937b88b4da435269a086d5132a6.jpg[/img]

New tankers arrive for both Midland Main Line and Great Western Express route Add-ons, allowing for heavy haulage across two arterial UK railway lines. The first of this gameplay pack series, Cargo Line Vol.1 - Petroleum, is out now!

[i]Save 10% with a launch discount on the Steam Store until 19th December![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/e67db960bd188d3afc6694b199d54536597e0ae2.jpg[/img]

For fans of freight, the addition of new and varied stock brings the possibility to operate more services and stock moves representative of the real world. In the first of this series of gameplay packs by Skyhook Games, both Midland Main Line and Great Western Express will see the VTG -branded TEA tankers on a selection of freight services across the timetables of both routes.

[h3][b]Midland Main Line – Updates and Cargo Line Vol.1 Services[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/3892f120aaabd83a7d5f5ed4891ad0761c80d091.jpg[/img]

A significant update has come to Midland Main Line this week on Train Sim World 4, which included a large range of improvements across the route to scenery, signage and textures, as well as well as fixes to key issues and the implementation of dynamic snow.

Train Sim World 4 players can also experience Midland Main Line with new TSW4 features, such as rain window effects, Scenario Planner 2.0 functionality and the new platinum medal scoring system across the timetable.

These Midland Main Line updates will have been made available from yesterday for players on TSW4, alongside the Winter Core (Part 1) updates, and we will share more news on when we can roll these out to Train Sim World 3 players in due course.

You can read the full list of [url=https://skyhookgames.com/train-sim-world-midland-main-line-december-update/][b]Midland Main Line updates[/b][/url] over on the Skyhook Games website.
You can also read more about the[url=https://forums.dovetailgames.com/threads/winter-core-update-part-1.76999/][b] Winter Core Update (Part 1)[/b][/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/be4f202c9667484f29effbea09eda8c956359bc2.jpg[/img]

[*] 06:12 6E46 Kingsbury Oil Sidings – Lindsey Oil Refinery
[*] 09:20 6M57 Lindsey Oil Refinery – Kingsbury Oil Sidings
[*] 12:55 6E54 Kingsbury Oil Sidings – Humber Oil Refinery

[*] 19:54 6E59 Kingsbury Oil Sidings – Lindsey Oil Refinery
[*] 20:05 6M24 Lindsey Oil Refinery – Kingsbury Oil Sidings

[*] 11:30 6V19 Grain Oil Terminal – Colnbrook Logistics
[*] 13:00 6O19 Colnbrook Logistics – Grain Oil Terminal

Train Sim World 4 players can also experience Midland Main Line with new TSW4 features, such as rain window effects, Scenario Planner 2.0 functionality and the new platinum medal scoring system across the timetable.
The update also facilitates the use of Cargo Line Vol.1 pack on this route, including the addition of Scenarios and timetable services.

Players with Great Western Express featuring the HST and Class 166 services between London Paddington and Reading will also be able make use of additional freight Scenarios and services on stretches of this route.

notes.title: Winter Core Update (Part 1) - Update Notes
notes.content:
This is the first part of our Winter Core Update, which includes new features and improvements for the Minimal HUD, Core fixes and various improvements to East Coast Main Line, Vorarlberg, Birmingham Cross City and a large list of changes from Skyhook Games coming to Midland Main Line, which you can view in full on their [url=https://skyhookgames.com/train-sim-world-midland-main-line-december-update/][b]Midland Main Line update page[/b][/url], based on the community feedback submitted by all of you.

The second part will include the Formation Designer, Suspension features as well as additional core improvements. We don't have an ETA on this, but you can expect us to talk more about the delivery for this update when we return in the new year.

[b]Core[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the Vorarlberg BR185 from moving in free roam
[*] Fixed a rare condition causing players to end up underneath the map when cycling through the passenger camera views.
[*] Fixed an issue where console players wouldn’t be able to input a Player Profile name after trying to enter a blank username.
[*] Fixed an issue where rain could appear underground and inside tunnels.
[*] Fixed an issue which limited substitutions for certain services and scenarios.
[*] Fixed an issue where PS4 players couldn’t import their profile from TSW2.
[*] Added Holiday Event 2023 Mastery decals – Find out more on our Festive Overview article!
[/list]

[b]Mini HUD Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] HUD settings will no longer reset between game sessions.
[*] Track Monitor will dynamically scale the distance based on current speed.
[*] If you are travelling at 0-80kmh, you will see a 1.5km distance ahead, which scales up to a 6km distance the faster you’re travelling.
[*] Added countdown progress bar to have options for 1km, 2km and 4km distance.
[*] Markers will appear correctly on the Track Monitor.
[*] Track Monitor should now correctly disappear when it is turned off in the settings.
[*] Track Monitor will be automatically hidden when on foot.
[*] Clock indicator will now correctly display when on foot.
[*] Added traction lock indicator to Minimal HUD
[*] Specific locos which don’t work with standard traction lock will not display.
[*] Simple HUD speedometer now goes up to 200mph.
[/list]

[b]Free Roam[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a Memory Usage indicator to the Free Roam spawning menu
[*] Fixed an issue where users were able to open to spawning menu whilst sat in a passenger seat. You can now only access the menu when on-foot.
[*] Scenario Planner
[*] Fixed an issue where passenger doors needed to be opened on the same side as the starting station.
[*] AI portals can now be used by multiple services so long as they have different starting times.
[*] Prevented duplicated objectives appearing on the schedule menu after completing a ‘Change Cabs’ objective.
[/list]

[b]Scoring[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rounding error so scoring breakdown and final score will always be the same value.
[/list]

[b]Photo Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] Photo Mode camera will no longer be able to escape map boundaries.
[/list]

[b]East Coast Main Line[/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected spelling errors in the 'Testing the Limits' scenario.
[*] [i]One of the posters on the route now has a familiar face on it. Can you find it?[/i]
[/list]
Class 801 Azuma
[list]
[*] Cab and Passenger lights are turned off when AUX Power is turned off.
[*] AI trains will no longer have looping diesel engine audio.
[/list]

[b]Flying Scotsman[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased volume of AWS sounds to an appropriate level.
[*] AI trains should now play a whistle/horn on routes with whistle boards.
[/list]

[b]Vorarlberg[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where an AI train arrives in double traction and interrupts the timetable at Bregenz Hafen.
[*] Fixed an issue where objectives appeared faded out in the 'Just Like in the Movies' scenario.
[*] Fixed an issue where passengers remain motionless after disembarking at Schlins Beschling station.
[/list]
ÖBB 4024
[list]
[*] Increased visibility of cab indicator lights during the daytime.
[*] Fixed an issue where acknowledging SIFA was inconsistent.
[*] Corrected spelling mistakes on interior coach and cab textures.
[/list]

[b]Maintalbahn[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Stopping boards in Miltenberg having text that reads "Hidden in Game".
[/list]

[b]Birmingham Cross City[/b]
West Midlands Railway Class 323
[list]
[*] Updated windows to use TSW4 rain weather effects. Added interactable Tail Lamps under the driver seats that are placeable on the cab window
[*] Cab car windows will now work as expected in dry and wet/snowy conditions
[*] Fixed an issue where PIS on AI trains didn’t work as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue where the secondman seats on AI trains were acting as a driver seat.
[*] Various localisation improvements to tooltips and tutorial text.
[/list]

Summary of the list of improvements that Skyhook Games has worked on for Midland Main Line:

[b]Midland Main Line[/b]
[list]
[*] Large range of improvements to scenery, textures, signage and vegetation across the route.
[*] Implementation of dynamic snow feature from TSW3.
[*] All collectibles can now be found and obtained. There are now correctly 25 of each set.
[*] Fix for the inability to acknowledge safety systems using a controller
[*] Fix to safety systems incorrectly triggering while driving
[*] Fix for game crash on PlayStation while driving the Class 43 HST.
[*] Fix to allow custom livery selection for the HST in the Timetable
[*] Many fixes to issues on the route, Class 158 DMU and Class 43 HST.
[*] Implementation of TSW4 rain effects
[*] Updated all scenarios to use TSW4 Platinum medals and Scoring 2.0 in the timetable.
[*] Updated to allow use of Scenario Planner 2.0 features.
[/list]

Skyhook have also put together a collection of screenshots comparing images before and after this update which you can view on their [url=https://www.flickr.com/photos/transrail/albums/72177720313061604/][b]Midland Main Line Update comparison photo library[/b][/url].

notes.title: Centro Regional Railways Class 323 – Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/5cb74d43185b0f17be810dd8895d2e960a3350c0.jpg[/img]

A new livery from a new developer comes to Birmingham Cross-City! Relive the suburban 1990s with the Centro Regional Railways BR Class 323 Add-on, releasing on 14th December.

[h3][b]Bringing back a brand: Centro[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/d23657f9113bce4d49d18815846335977f3a5ea3.jpg[/img]

For West Midlands commuters of a certain age, the Centro livery will be a familiar sight, once being the bold branding for public transport across Birmingham and the wider Black Country. The Centro brand was introduced in 1990, just as the railways were shifting away from the nationalised British Rail brand and heading towards the privatisation of the mid 1990s. Its logo featured across both bus and railway stations, as well as the Class 323 units introduced to the Birmingham Cross-City Line. In 2005, Centro became Network West Midlands and the colour schemes were updated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/7c686bd4c2dd6617e5bc75b3ea84561939ef0a1e.jpg[/img]

Last year, current operator West Midlands Railways decided to bring back the Centro livery to one of its Class 323 units: no.323221. After its new (old) livery was applied at Soho Depot, the unit re-entered service on 19th December 2022.

[h3][b]Centro Regional Railways Class 323[/b][/h3]

SimTrack are a new Partner Programme Developer to Train Sim World, making its debut by bringing 323221’s livery to life in-game. You can read a little more about SimTrack in our [url=https://live.dovetailgames.com/live/train-sim-world/articles/article/train-sim-world-4-roadmap-november-2023][b]November Roadmap[/b][/url], where they introduce themselves to the Train Sim World Community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/1e7da4abd086747578301ea5d974ca02c6d775cc.jpg[/img]

The Centro Regional Railways BR Class 323 Add-on brings the Centro livery to the current Class 323. The green, blue and yellow tones, though evoking the classic livery of the past, is produced in its current form as seen on 323221, with full-length yellow doors, the narrow grey band at the top and yellow light clusters.

Additional features and updates on this version of the Class 323 include:
[list]
[*] Interactive Stabling Tail Lamp under the driver’s seat, required during two of the additional Scenarios
[*] Updated Train Sim World 4 rain effects on the windscreen
[*] Toggleable ‘Hunslet the Bear’ sitting in the cab!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/5d8bf40e22e6f12acf052ffe23d95f180e63b323.jpg[/img]

Five new Scenarios will also be added to Birmingham Cross-City as part of this Add-on, which feature some additions to the environmentsuch as Flashing Emergency Indicators.

Some minor updates and improvements to the West Midlands Railway Class 323, such as fixed PIS displays and the Secondman seat now being usable, will also be implemented for Train Sim World 4 players that own Birmingham Cross-City.

[b]Centro Regional Railways BR Class 323 Add-on[/b] will be available from December 14th for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for [b]£4.99/€5.99/$5.99[/b]

Making use of the Add-on and its Scenarios requires Train Sim World 4 and the Train Sim World Compatible: Birmingham Cross-City Line route Add-on.

[h3][b]Birmingham Cross-City Line: Lichfield - Bromsgrove & Redditch[/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=d-uq66yIOb4;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386150/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible__Birmingham_CrossCity_Line_Lichfield__Bromsgrove__Redditch_Route_AddOn/

Centred around England’s second city of Birmingham, Birmingham Cross-City takes in the impressive Lickey Incline at the southern end of the route, the famous Cadbury Factory and station at Bournville and the short branch line to Redditch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/4568f7e8be6dcde4247a6479db84df37dc913b58.jpg[/img]

The West Midlands Railway Class 323 is included, whisking West Midlands commuters and travellers in and out of the iconic Birmingham New Street station and off north to the cathedral city of Lichfield or south to the Worcestershire town of Bromsgrove.

Train Sim World 4 players can also utilise Free Roam and Photo Mode in the route, along with Volumetric Fog.

[i]Screenshots show Birmingham Cross-City with the Centro Regional Railways Class 323 Add-on installed.[/i]

Train Sim World Compatible: Birmingham Cross-City Line: Lichfield - Bromsgrove & Redditch is available for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for [b]£29.99/€35.99/$39.99[/b]

Find out more about Train Sim World 4 by following @trainsimworld on [b][url=https://twitter.com/trainsimworld]Twitter[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/trainsim/]Instagram[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/trainsimworld]Facebook[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/user/RailSimulatorDotCom]YouTube[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/trainsimworldofficial]Twitch[/url][/b], and [b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@trainsimworldofficial]TikTok[/url][/b].

notes.title: Maintalbahn - Out Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=m7os5SQzoJY;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s time to top up the fuel tank and fire up the engine – Maintalbahn: Aschaffenburg – Miltenberg with the DB BR 642 DMU is Out Now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566220/Train_Sim_World_4_Maintalbahn_Aschaffenburg__Miltenberg_Route_AddOn/

[h3][b]The Route[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/05e7ef5901c3759016f188ce6dde2965dd739465.jpg[/img]

Take to the countryside through the northwestern reaches of the Bavaria state and the Franken region, where a proud sense of local identity is found. Though players of our previous route, Main-Spessart Bahn, might be familiar with Aschaffenburg, the station and area have been entirely remade for this route Add-on, with signalling and track being reworked to bring the area up to the standards of Train Sim World 4.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/306768c673ae661cfb27e437e91a463c3eea930d.jpg[/img]

Services wind along the Main Valley as far as Miltenberg when many of the real-world passenger services end, as do the local freight trains serving the industry in the area. This single-track lines spread over 37km, with various passing places, features 14 stations each with their own details as well as other features between them. Additional track at Aschaffenburg Port takes the total length of the route up to 41km and it is here where those completing the Mastery Challenges will be able to see a ship launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/b8a257f8a0206419b223b5f0d2d20af4db4d5c13.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Units and Locomotives[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/2facab43a6fe63aee79ee59195763e778d08f992.jpg[/img]

Being introduced to Train Sim World as part of this route is the DB BR 642 DMU, seen across a number of lines throughout Germany operating commuter lines in its 2-car formation, innovative low floor and large windows allowing the scenery to shine through for passengers.

[previewyoutube=8OVIq1VYdjg;full][/previewyoutube]

Though not the most powerful DMU in the world, this widespread unit offers some additional diesel traction to use in Free Roam on other German routes and allows for the likes of refuelling to take place as part of both Scenarios and the service timetable. The model represents the DMU in a great amount of detail, with sounds sourced as a result of both Lukas’ in-person recording trip and from others with relevant material.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/4542f43797d98e076708374b7a4d3aa8d22d3019.jpg[/img]

The DB BR 363 shunting locomotive in blue livery adds yet more diesel action to the route, hauling DB Habbiins and Roos-t Wagons. Operating across the full length of the route, but in stages, this locomotive serves the local industry on the line, giving way to passenger trains in passing loops throughout the day to keep the timetable moving to time. With appearances in other Train Sim World routes, the DB BR 363 also brings some familiar traction to the route for players.

[h3][b]Services, layers and gameplay[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/6404f72388f6f650abb6042e4e4cb15ba833127b.jpg[/img]

Though some real-world services pass through Miltenberg and continue onwards to elsewhere on the network such as Wertheim, others terminate at Miltenberg, before heading back to Aschaffenburg. The RB 88 service is roughly hourly and calls at most if not all stations whereas the RE 87 is a semi-fast run, stopping at less stations. There are also shorter shuttles between Aschaffenburg and Aschaffenburg South, and depot/shunt manoeuvres at either end of the line, including refuelling services using the facilities at Aschaffenburg.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/08ed82b05321cc911de6a8555063805a44430036.jpg[/img]

The BR 363 shunts freight wagons and delivers them to and from Aschaffenburg port, as well as a couple of main line runs, split into parts as a result of the single-track necessitating waits for paths, similar to how freight services operate on Niddertalbahn. These main line runs cover the whole route, ending at Miltenberg.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/29d8768b2b12cb78b0781fcbabe4d7415bc2e9a9.jpg[/img]

Players with other German Train Sim World routes will no doubt want to make use of the DB BR 642 in Free Roam and take it to other familiar haunts for the DMU, or beyond! Though Niddertalbahn in-game may be set in the early 1990s, these units have been in operation along the route in more recent times, offering an alternative rural, single-track route to take the DB BR 642 along. Similarly those with Dresden - Riesa (since upgraded for Train Sim World 4 players) may wish to Free Roam the 642 in and around the Dresden area.

The DB BR 642 also substitutes into services on the Tharandter Rampe: Dresden – Chemnitz route Add-on.

Players with Niddertalbahn and Train Sim World 4 will have received the updated red DB livery for the Class 628.2 and this version of the older DMU class will substitute into all of Maintalbahn’s playable 642 services. The DB BR 612 from Tharandter Rampe is also available to operate in place of the 642 services.

There’ll also be substitutions with the red liveried DB BR 363 into the freight services for those that own the separate locomotive Add-on as well as the DB G6 Diesel Shunter loco Add-on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/f6bc68589122b6da13dfdc218bbd7f1bca04e199.jpg[/img]

At Aschaffenburg, there’ll be a series of AI layers from other German Train Sim World routes, including:
[list]
[*] [b]Bremen[/b] - Oldenburg: DB BR 425
[*] [b]Kassel - Würzburg[/b]: DB BR 401 ICE 1
[*] [b]S-Bahn Vorarlberg[/b]: DB BR 185
[*] [b]Railpool BR 193 Vectron[/b]
[*] [b]Dresden - Riesa[/b]: Zacns Wagons
[*] [b]Main-Spessart Bahn[/b]: DB BR 146 and Doppelstock
[/list]

Unlike electrified routes, the concept of refuelling is a consideration in both the timetable and in Scenarios. Extra runs to refuel are implemented into the service timetable and a specific Scenario ‘Running on Vapors’ will place the player in a predicament whereby they’ll need to make it to the next station with enough fuel remaining... a new feature in Train Sim World!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/a37f428fc781e5abd31bc188bf6ebae04786bb72.jpg[/img]

The standard route maps and first aid kits will appear as collectibles along the route, as well as Insect Hotels which can be seen at various stations in the real-world route, allowing local wildlife to thrive in an otherwise human environment.

Train Sim World 4: Maintalbahn: Aschaffenburg – Miltenberg route Add-on is available now for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for £24.99/€29.99/$29.99.

If you missed the Railfan TV team last week, you can still head over to Twitch and YouTube for a bi-lingual preview of Train Sim World 4: Maintalbahn: Aschaffenburg – Miltenberg. English and German parts of the livestream are timestamped in the description, including questions asked by you, the Community, from the Forum’s Q&A thread.

[previewyoutube=A6JLdj2QU9k;full][/previewyoutube]

Find out more about Train Sim World 4 by following @trainsimworld on [b][url=https://twitter.com/trainsimworld]Twitter[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/trainsim/]Instagram[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/trainsimworld]Facebook[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/user/RailSimulatorDotCom]YouTube[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/trainsimworldofficial]Twitch[/url][/b], and [b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@trainsimworldofficial]TikTok[/url][/b].

notes.title: Steam Autumn Sale - Now On!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/ae0fd09494da446c5e814293bb9a1ca3fcec2a08.jpg[/img]

The Steam Autumn Sale is now on, with huge savings to be had on Train Sim World content!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/tswofficial/][b]View All the Content on Sale Here [/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/e11e88625dc519befb04c0be38f4eb6e218c25b2.jpg[/img]

Still waiting to enjoy all new features like Free Roam, Photo Mode and Volumetric Fog? Train Sim World 4 offers this and more with updates to Livery Designer, Scenario Planner and access to the PC Editor (beta), where ambitious players can create their own Train Sim World content!

There's also some first time sales on Steam for some of the latest Train Sim World Compatible content - like the highly detailed 1990s branch line: Niddertalbahn and the modern Thameslink Class 700 Add-on for Southeastern Highspeed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/bde62cb708c1d5e4437be58a04e3a3323596fa8d.jpg[/img]

If you like red and white trains... there's plenty of those in the sale from Germany and beyond! Hit high speeds in the iconic ICE 1 between Kassel and Würzburg, or head off towards Aachen from Köln with the sleek ICE 3.

For fans of Swiss railways, there's also the Luzern - Sursee route Add-on in the sale, which also adds service layers to Train Sim World 4's S-Bahn Vorarlberg, which sits on and near the German, Swiss and Austrian borders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/13b200d2436569404de2b1ec165e4164684e5684.jpg[/img]

If Swiss content is your thing, then make sure you check out the latest Gameplay Pack by Rivet Games: RhB Arosa Aggregates Pack, which released this week.

Whilst this pack isn't in the sale, the route Add-on required in order to make use of it is! Train Sim World Compatible: Arosalinie: Chur – Arosa is now 25% off. There's also a handy Steam Bundle containing both pieces of content and the 'Complete My Collection' feature, meaning you can still save even if you own some of the content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/77725cee242794505a5c81112c7a1256a0bf8b33.jpg[/img]

Modern electric, British Rail freight and Midlands passenger services and more are all available in the sale, with many offering additional services for those with Train Sim World 4 content.

Southeastern Highspeed and Skyhook Games' Midland Main Line route Add-ons layer in additional freight and Class 158 services into Train Sim World 4's East Coast Main Line, bringing a busier timetable to the route, whereas Tees Valley Line will provide some additional rolling stock and AI services for players that recently picked up Just Trains' Blackpool Branches route Add-on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/844bf43a94830614c269e1327e75d0b61a5c2ec0.jpg[/img]

If you're into US passenger services and have enjoyed Train Sim World 4's Antelope Valley Line, then now is the perfect time to try out more Californian Commuter trains, with Peninsula Corridor and the MP36PH-3C loco Add-on now half price!

These two Add-ons have received some hefty improvements in recent months, which you can read about over on our Train Sim World 4 Launch Day Mega Patch Forum Thread.

notes.title: RhB Arosa Aggregates Pack - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/392c6fe77466b99ffcb944aeea8ad94c3c2fbcac.jpg[/img]

Mix up the worlds of passenger and freight with the RhB Arosa Aggregates Pack by Rivet Games - Out Now as a Gameplay Pack for the Train Sim World Compatible: Arosalinie: Chur – Arosa route Add-on!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584070/Train_Sim_World_4_RhB_Arosa_Aggregates_Pack/

[h2][b]Train Sim World 4: RhB Arosa Aggregates Pack[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/1b762f8978eb7d660fc03527437c8604e890a055.jpg[/img]

Passenger & freight often combine on RhB rails into dual-purpose operations. All-new Swiss stone-laden services will be available to master through the mountains of Train Sim World: Arosalinie, which is required, along with Train Sim World 4, in order to make use of this pack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/6b6cc0685a3e76e7bd6d66c588f1a247928db1e0.jpg[/img]

Included are the FAC wagon and two new Ge 4/4 ii liveries:
[list]
[*] No. 622 Hakone Tozan Railway, commemorating the Rhätische Bahn’s Japanese partner.
[*] No. 629 Neubau Albulatunnel, celebrating the construction of the new Albula tunnel.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/630241e1380407b52cf5ecbfffd2dce8a482778c.jpg[/img]

It’s your job to carefully haul FAC wagons, attached to the rear of passenger trains, up to 1km in altitude from Chur to Arosa, shunt them into the terminal for unloading, before reattaching them for the nail-biting downhill run. You will also have the unique opportunity to mix freight with the existing SP-W timber wagon, operate a stand-in mail delivery service with the Gepackwagen, and rescue a stranded service in harsh conditions.

The mail service offers something particularly interactive, with the need to pick up a mailbag in Chur and put it in the baggage car. You'll need to then collect mail from the bag and walk over to the post boxes at each station on the route to deliver the mail!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/c4f727b0bbd15097a56deaacc68cbe37cd1ee9a4.jpg[/img]

Train Sim World 4: RhB Arosa Aggregates Pack is out now for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for [b]€11.99/$14.99/£9.99[/b]

If you missed the First Look video of the Pack that Rivet Games posted earlier, you can check it out below:
[previewyoutube=qHoW3JDYeX0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Train Sim World Compatible: Arosalinie: Chur – Arosa[/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375910/Train_Sim_World_4_Compatible_Arosalinie_Chur__Arosa_Route_AddOn/

For those yet to experience the route, it is available for Train Sim World 4 as Train Sim World Compatible content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/ef33eba3a7d4b3b3ff302ce7e60a06e002a6dfca.jpg[/img]

Nestled high in the Swiss peaks, the Arosa Line winds its way along mountain ridges and across towering valleys, while also squeezing through the streets of Chur. A vital passenger route, granted, but also among the mix is a series of rail-served industries, including an aggregate terminal sat just outside of Arosa station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/70cdb56bfa2c9aef1986653ce25f8b3ffd2239b8.jpg[/img]

The RhB Ge 4/4 ii is a classic metre-gauge locomotive, well suited to the task of hauling trains through the Swiss mountains.

Train Sim World Compatible: Arosalinie: Chur – Arosa is available for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for [b]€29.99/$29.99/£24.99[/b]

[i]Screenshots show the route Add-on with the additional Gameplay Pack installed.[/i]

[h3][b]Edinburgh - Glasgow: Engineering Express Pack Update[/b][/h3]

When we announced the two gameplay packs from Rivet Games in November's Roadmap, we had planned to release the Edinburgh - Glasgow: Engineering Express Pack for the ScotRail Express Edinburgh - Glasgow route Add-on, alongside the Arosa Aggregates Pack. However, due to unforeseen circumstances, we will not be releasing this content today. We apologise for any inconvenience caused.

When we have a release date, we will share it with you. Thanks for your patience and understanding, and we hope you enjoy the RhB Arosa Aggregates Pack.

notes.title: Maintalbahn - Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Deutsche diesel duty comes to port with the forthcoming arrival of the DB BR 642 in Maintalbahn: Aschaffenburg – Miltenberg from November 28th. Pre-order on Steam for a 10% discount!

[previewyoutube=vYPqjnq_nqE;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566220/Train_Sim_World_4_Maintalbahn_Aschaffenburg__Miltenberg_Route_AddOn/

[h3][b]Locomotives and Units[/b][/h3]
[b]Introducing: DB BR 642 DMU[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/9addce9607b165260cea30e7896b5fb2f93a2873.jpg[/img]

Where we’re going, we don’t need... wires. The DB BR 642, new to Train Sim World, has become common sight in recent decades on rural branch lines, with its diesel power moving passengers on non-electrified routes since their introduction in the late 1990s.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/1ec4d72bc0c825da6c34ac47461edf49e01409af.jpg[/img]

These 2-car multiple units feature an innovative low floor and boarding design for increased accessibility and are mounted upon a shared bogie to improve safety and ride quality. The low floor also gives the 642 its distinctive large windows for ultimate scenic viewing – particularly for passengers travelling along the scenic Main Valley.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/7287ab386184532313b9786e5d7c0a399354e68d.jpg[/img]

With Free Roam a popular feature in Train Sim World 4, players with additional route Add-ons will have the ability to take the 642 elsewhere across the German network too! Though Niddertalbahn in-game may be set in the early 1990s, the DB BR 642 has been in operation along the route in more recent times. Similarly those with Dresden - Riesa (since upgraded for Train Sim World 4 players) may wish to Free Roam the 642 in and around the Dresden area.

[b]Freight Loco: DB BR 363[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/fdb9028711a6da20fdb671183001a4c39d449012.jpg[/img]

Joining in on the diesel action is the DB BR 363 shunting locomotive in blue livery, hauling DB Habbiins and Roos-t Wagons. Developed in the late 1950s, this formidable shunter was produced in good numbers, with 942 being delivered by the time production ceased in 1964.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/f4ba06c6bceec71ab645cce1ba697874a0484baf.jpg[/img]

Players of previous German Train Sim World routes will find this locomotive a familiar entry point into exploring the Maintalbahn route and running services in between the passenger trains, negotiating the single-track sections in order to let them through on time.

[h3][b]The Route[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/5c8e5069b60a25273ccd98857948937c2a5b778b.jpg[/img]

Located in the westernmost part of Bavaria, the Main Valley winds its way through scenic countryside, with the railway line following the course of the river throughout. This single-track line features a varied service pattern for the DB BR 642 as well as the local freight trains servicing industry in the area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/934e6ab9910baa6eed9b9a1c41e70b13cb7c3ce2.jpg[/img]

Aschaffenburg will be familiar to players of the previous Main Spessart Bahn route Add-on, which instead cut across country to join the Main Valley at Gemünden much further along. This portside town is served my multiple stations in addition to Aschaffenburg Hauptbahnhof, which forms the northernmost stop in Maintalbahn.

Fourteen stations in total lie along the route, with Miltenburg forming the southern endpoint for in-game services.

Completing the Tier 2 Mastery Challenge will also add further drama to the scenery, with a ship launch to unlock!

[h3][b]Services, layers and gameplay[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/1c44580df0a66f3f362d77cb511633108da98df3.jpg[/img]

The passenger experience is primarily full length runs. The RB 88 service is roughly hourly and calls at most if not all stations. RE 87 is a semi-fast run, stopping at less stations. There are also shorter shuttles between Aschaffenburg and Aschaffenburg South, and depot/shunt manoeuvres at either end of the line.

The BR 363 shunts freight wagons and delivers them to and from Aschaffenburg port, as well as a couple of mainline runs, split into parts as a result of the single-track necessitating waits for paths, similar to how freight services operate on Niddertalbahn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/59bedd53e0cab1dd385cd0c17d1035037f509306.jpg[/img]

Players with Niddertalbahn and Train Sim World 4 will have received the updated red DB livery for the Class 628.2 and this version of the older DMU class will substitute into all of Maintalbahn’s 642 services. The DB BR 612 from Tharandter Rampe also subs into the 642 services.

There’ll also be substitutions with the red liveried DB BR 363 into the freight services for those that own the separate locomotive Add-on.

At Aschaffenburg, there’ll be a series of AI layers from other German Train Sim World routes, including:
[list]
[*] Bremen - Oldenburg: DB BR 425
[*] Kassel - Würzburg: DB BR 401 ICE 1
[*] S-Bahn Vorarlberg: DB BR 185
[*] Railpool BR 193 Vectron
[*] Dresden - Riesa: Zacns Wagons
[*] Main-Spessart Bahn: DB BR 146 and Doppelstock
[/list]

There’ll be a handful of Scenarios to choose from, including the unique ‘Running on Vapors’ Scenario in which you’ll need to manage your fuel usage to complete your service without running out of fuel! You’ll start with a minimal amount and will have to fill up once you get to a refuelling point.

Train Sim World 4: Maintalbahn: Aschaffenburg – Miltenberg route Add-on will be available from November 28th for [b]€29.99/£24.99/$29.99[/b]

[b]You can pre-order the route now on Steam with 10% off![/b]

Join the Railfan TV team on Twitch and YouTube at 18:00 UTC on Tuesday November 21st for a preview of Train Sim World 4: Maintalbahn: Aschaffenburg – Miltenberg.

Find out more about Train Sim World 4 by following @trainsimworld on [b][url=https://twitter.com/trainsimworld]Twitter[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/trainsim/]Instagram[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/trainsimworld]Facebook[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/user/RailSimulatorDotCom]YouTube[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/trainsimworldofficial]Twitch[/url][/b], and [b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@trainsimworldofficial]TikTok[/url][/b].

notes.title: Blackpool Branches - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/cb3906d96bb31a00fdc4e04e39379edca19e93c4.png[/img]

The first route Add-on for Train Sim World 4 has arrived! The journey up to now with Partner Programme Developer Just Trains has been full of fascinating development insights, teases, previews and information, all with today in mind. [b]Blackpool Branches: Preston – Blackpool & Ormskirk is out now![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386172/Train_Sim_World_4_Blackpool_Branches_Preston__Blackpool__Ormskirk_Route_AddOn/

If you want to go back and relive the build-up to this eagerly awaiting British route Add-on, you can check out the various announcements below:
[list]
[*] [url=https://live.dovetailgames.com/live/train-sim-world/articles/article/train-sim-world-roadmap-june-2023][b]June Roadmap:[/b][/url] First Tease Screenshot of route in progress
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m70P3K7zAys][b]Dovetail Direct:[/b][/url] Announcement of Blackpool Branches
[*] [url=https://live.dovetailgames.com/live/train-sim-world/articles/article/train-sim-world-roadmap-october-2023][b]October Roadmap:[/b][/url] Work in Progress Screenshots
[*] [url=https://live.dovetailgames.com/live/train-sim-world/articles/article/blackpool-branches-coming-soon][b]Coming Soon Article:[/b][/url] Release date announce and full details
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IlOn_z11sJo][b]Preview Stream[/b][/url] – featuring Special Guests from Just Trains
[/list]

[h3][b]Pace yourselves! Take control of the Class 142[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/355fb1ecdf38980f57294dbbe35b85823311ccab.jpg[/img]

You know the saying: [i]“You wait all day for a Pacer and then three turn up at once!”[/i]

These marmite, love/hate DMUs from the 1980s have been a running joke for decades on the British railway network, before slowly transforming into an adored relic from a time when cheap and cheerful maybe wasn’t as cheerful as it should have been. Initially planned to be temporary replacements for older DMUs, the Pacer classes eventually saw active service well into the 21st century and were withdrawn as recently as 2021 to fulfil a second life on heritage railways up and down the country.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/b1cc26b04285a06b90b3fca16d629e2f61bf2b5d.jpg[/img]

In Blackpool Branches: Preston – Blackpool & Ormskirk, you can take control of this ‘bus on rails’ on local services around Lancashire circa 1986, when the units were fresh on the network ferrying holidaymakers and locals to Blackpool and beyond.

The Class 142 comes to Blackpool Branches in three liveries: BR Provincial Blue, Skipper Chocolate & Cream and Greater Manchester Orange and though this is purely a visual difference, there are in fact internal ones as well. There are multiple engine and transmission variants, including:
[list]
[*] Leyland TL11 + SCG RRE5
[*] Leyland TL11 + Voith T211r
[*] Cummins LTA10-R + Voith T211r
[/list]

These power arrangements have their own differences in sound, which have been worked on using audio from a variety of sources, including Armstrong Powerhouse for the Cummins recordings. During development, it became apparent that no Pacer units with the older variants of engine and transmission were running and therefore were not made available to record. As a result, audio was curated and sourced from Dovetail Games and the Leyland engine used in the Class 101, plus some personal recordings. These sound sets have been expertly applied to the Pacer by Ed Fisk.

There are other unique details included with the Pacer, such as the interactable Public Address (PA) handset in the cab, which you can use to broadcast a set of service announcements when driving on both Blackpool Branches and West Cornwall Local (for players that own that route). The Pacer also features functionality with the new Train Sim World 4 suspension system.

If you want to get to know the Class 142 Pacer in-game, check out our First Look video:

[previewyoutube=dXEDpqgGL2c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Duffs and Gronks – Additional Rolling Stock[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/968aedcb79d0260fe8ca6ae575d2d5b55a8f93fb.jpg[/img]

Fleshing out the timetable and bringing new liveries to these old favourites are two perennial locomotives from the height of the BR blue days. The Class 47/4, previously seen in Northern Trans-Pennine, and the Class 08, previously seen in both Tees Valley Line and BR Heavy Freight Pack join the Pacer on freight, passenger and shunting services across the network of Lancashire branches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/da025f1ca71018fc70cafd95ee7020f354249827.jpg[/img]

The Class 47/4 is available to haul Mk1 newspaper/parcels trains, Mk2 passenger trains and TEA Tanker Wagons in BR Blue, BR Large Logo and BR Intercity liveries and features a high intensity headlamp. Whereas the Class 08 can be operated in shunting moves in two new variants of the BR Blue livery: a Crewe depot variant and that of 08744 Wigan TMD with a white roof.

Both locomotives have had other changes and updates specific to this route Add-on, including some retexturing, lighting changes and smoke effects. You can see the full list of Class 47/4 and Class 08 changes in Just Trains’ Dev Update.

These locomotives and items of rolling stock are all included with Blackpool Branches: Preston - Blackpool & Ormskirk.

[h3][b]The Route[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/b3647a85851ef1bc9b8217586a9a4e0af55472f9.jpg[/img]

Both Blackpool North and Blackpool South stations feature on separate branch lines, along with the Ormskirk branch to the south and disused Burn Naze branch to the north. Along the way, plenty of landmarks from the area can be admired throughout the environment including the iconic Blackpool Tower and an animated rollercoaster at Blackpool’s Pleasure Beach. Ainscough’s Mill, Preston Ribble Viaduct, St Warlburge’s Church and Warbreck Hill Water Tower also feature as easily recognisable features of the Lancashire landscape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/ea98ec0aca89fdb4e75b0c9bbd33e927322a75a5.jpg[/img]

Exploring the route on foot yields other finer details. A number of signal boxes can be entered with modelled interiors to admire as the trains pass by and the customary collectibles are around to hunt down, from posters and signs to golf clubs and... gingerbread!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/c7ef17af4fbe97b0b9395116b5990ffe8cabe8a5.jpg[/img]

Volumetric Fog and improved rain effects seen in Train Sim World 4’s core routes are utilised fully in Blackpool Branches to give real drama and atmosphere to this part of northwest England.

[h3][b]Services and Layers[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/940b4615707b28115c9198aecd9198cf7df540eb.jpg[/img]

Passenger, freight and shunting services are available with the route utilising all three units and locomotives and the 24-hour cycle based on a full, real-world timetable includes over 250 playable services.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/5392cba33a4e2284c02934a023b09c7bbe2faa31.jpg[/img]

There will also be additional services for players that own the following Train Sim World Compatible routes and locomotives:

[list]
[*] [b]Tees Valley Line:[/b] for the Class 101 DMU.
[*] [b]West Cornwall Local:[/b] for the Seacow Wagons.
[*] [b]Northern TransPennine:[/b] for the Class 45 Diesel locomotive.
[*] [b]Spirit of Steam:[/b] for the LMS Stanier 8F steam locomotive, Mk1 Coaches, 16t Mineral Wagon and 20t Brake Van.
[*] [b]BR Heavy Freight Pack:[/b] for the Class 40 Diesel locomotive.
[*] [b]BR Class 31 Loco Add-On[/b]
[*] [b]BR Class 20 Loco Add-On[/b]
[/list]

In addition, Tees Valley Line and West Cornwall Local will implement AI services using the Class 37 and wagons from those route Add-ons.

There’ll be five Scenarios included: Two with the Class 142 Pacer, two with the Class 47/4 and one shunting Scenario with the Class 08. Pacers will need rescuing; shuttles will need shuffling and passengers from the south will have an illuminated evening.

[h3][b]Mastery Challenges[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534860/5767700b481ea2152030e134c0bb653d581e7658.jpg[/img]

As with the majority of Train Sim World route Add-ons, both decals and an optional Scenery Tile can be unlocked by completing a series of challenges along Blackpool Branches:

[list]
[*] Tier 1: Complete 1 Scenario and earn 500 AP
[*] Tier 2: Drive 75 miles / 120 km and complete 4 Scenarios
[/list]

You can track your Mastery progress on other routes by logging into Dovetail Live and selecting My Profile at the top of the page, or in-game by logging in and heading to Mastery in the main menu.

[i]Note: We're aware of an issue which means that, at the moment, the Tier 2 Mastery Reward will not unlock. You can still complete challenges, and your progress will track for the post-release update which will enable it. Please keep an eye on our [url=https://forums.dovetailgames.com/forums/announcements.73/][b]Announcements forum[/b][/url] for more details of patch update contents. Thanks for your patience, and we hope you enjoy the route![/i]

[h3][b]Substitutions and Free Roam[/b][/h3]

Players with the West Cornwall Local route Add-on will also get the chance to operate the Class 142 Pacer along both the main line from St Austell to Penzance and on the St Ives branch in timetable mode, substituting in for the Class 150.

Players with Northern Trans-Pennine will also see the new Class 47/4 liveries substitute into timetables in place of existing Class 47 services.

And with Free Roam now a feature in Train Sim World 4, those who own other route Add-ons may wish to run both the Pacer and updated Class 47/4 and Class 08 locomotives elsewhere, such as Tees Valley Line … or, put the Pacer on Antelope Valley Line, if you really want to!

Just Trains have put together a [url=https://dxhb0it26is40.cloudfront.net/manuals/Blackpool_Branches_Preston_Blackpool_and_Ormskirk_TSW4_Manual.pdf][b]Blackpool Branches Manual[/b][/url] that covers everything you need to know about Blackpool Branches, which you download from their website.

Train Sim World 4: Blackpool Branches: Preston - Blackpool & Ormskirk route Add-on is out now for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Epic Games Store, and Steam for £29.99/€35.99/$39.99.

If you missed the Railfan TV team previewing the route, with special guests Just Trains answering your questions, you can head back and watch on YouTube and Twitch.

[previewyoutube=IlOn_z11sJo;full][/previewyoutube]
